For energy baseline prediction, two main approaches, ‘‘physical modeling and data-driven modeling’’, are used [8].

Several data-driven algorithms are used to predict energy baseline in buildings, some of the most prominent are the linear regression model, Gaussian process model, support vector machines (SVMs), and Artificial neural networks (ANNs).
Data-driven and physics-based approaches are combined in a hybrid approaches [24].
